status: research baseline, not a verified routing database

rules.structure: Use per-way bridge/tunnel/embankment evidence and measured terrain. layer is relative order, not metres. Unknown is not automatically elevated.
rules.driveability: Check motor_vehicle/access/oneway and physical road class. Exclude pedestrian bridges, stairways and gondola cables.
rules.water: River, estuary and open sea are distinct; no generic blue-water plane on every mountain route.
rules.connections: Retain compressed links as explicitly fictional transitions until real road connectivity is verified.
rules.geometry: Local x/z reference data without a WGS84 origin cannot be advertised as georeferenced.
